text: Alice was not hurt at all. <break time="0.8s" /> And far ahead she saw. <break time="0.8s" /> The White Rabbit hurrying away. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh my ears and whiskers. <break time="0.8s" /> How late it is getting. <break time="0.8s" /> It cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice ran after it. <break time="0.8s" /> But when she turned the corner. <break time="0.8s" /> The Rabbit was gone. <break time="0.8s" /> She was in a long, low hall. <break time="0.8s" /> Which was lit. <break time="0.8s" /> By a row of lamps. <break time="0.8s" /> There were doors. <break time="0.8s" /> All around the hall. <break time="0.8s" /> But they were all locked. <break time="0.8s" /> Then she found. <break time="0.8s" /> A little three legged table. <break time="0.8s" /> That was made of solid glass. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a tiny golden key on it. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was too small. <break time="0.8s" /> For the doors. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind a low curtain. <break time="0.8s" /> She found a little door. <break time="0.8s" /> About fifteen inches high. <break time="0.8s" /> She tried the golden key. <break time="0.8s" /> In the lock. <break time="0.8s" /> And to her great delight. <break time="0.8s" /> It fitted. <break time="0.8s" /> The door opened. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a small passage. <break time="0.8s" /> Which led to the loveliest garden. <break time="0.8s" /> Alice wanted to go out. <break time="0.8s" /> But she could not even get her head. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the doorway. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh, how I wish. <break time="0.8s" /> I could shut up like a telescope. <break time="0.8s" /> She said.
